flows.name: Load the authenticated user's Tasks
steps: Resolve the user's profile and person record through the service data owner
Read tasks through serviceDb and apply the in-route mine scope filters
Reject missing-email and non-admin all-scope requests
flows.expectedOutcome: An authenticated user can receive only their task list without browser-side table permissions or scope escalation

claims.description: The authenticated mine scope reads through the canonical server-only data owner and retains assignee filtering
A session without an email returns a typed authentication error before any broad task read
A non-admin cannot request all tasks
